videos.description:
A showcase of Hathor's gameplay to fully appreciate every detail in each of her animations.

As someone who uses her as a burst DPS, I did NOT expect her to attack using her legs (that is not a complaint in any way). Her basic attacks are probably my favorite part of her kit animation-wise, as I like the way they feel so floaty and strong at the same time, and each one of them feel equally as good as the other. Her Redirect Skill, charged attack, and plunge attack feel a little weak in comparison, although I do like how she has a unique plunge attack (animation-wise tho, it also feels weak). Her ultimate is just fine, tho I feel they could've done a bit more with it. One thing I didn't know was that she could ride motorcycles herself, until I someone else do it, which I think is a really cool unique feature of hers (and I hope that gets extended to more characters in the future). 7/10 for me.

The little animations she does after each attack are also really cute and add to her personality. 10/10 for me.

videos.title: Hotori Animations Showcase (Combat, Exploration, Menu, Unique Skills)
videos.description:
A showcase of Hotori's gameplay to fully appreciate every detail in each of her animations.

Since Hotori is an ultimate-focused character, it's only natural for her to have the best ultimate animations (including the ultimate attacks) in the game. One thing I really appreciate is how even her ultimate attacks each have their own sheathing animation (and BOY am I glad her ultimate recharges over time so I didn't have to farm energy over and over again to showcase each one). It's something they didn't HAVE to do, but it really shows how much effort they put into each character's animations. They even added a PLUNGE attack for her ultimate, even though no one would even THINK of plunging during it (I fogor to showcase it cuz of that mb). The rest of her animations are just fine for me, but I also do like the way she floats with her umbrella after her basic attacks, which are just nice to look at. 7/10 for me.

Guess I'm a showcase channel now.
